question: The LCM of two numbers is 450. If the product of the two numbers is 20250, then find their HCF.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Product of numbers = **LCM** × **HCF**

20250 = 450 × **HCF**

**HCF** = 20250 ÷ 450 = 2025 ÷ 45

**HCF** = 45

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**LCM** of two numbers = 450

**Product** of two numbers = 20250

**Formula Used:**

First Number × Second Number = **LCM** × **HCF**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a44286bca4a97f2825707b9541f679f3ae0e04626994d21c1f847b46211cf93.png] 
**Calculations:**

⇒ **Product** = **LCM** × **HCF**

⇒ 20250 = 450 × **HCF**

⇒ **HCF** = 20250 ÷ 450

⇒ **HCF** = 2025 ÷ 45

⇒ **HCF** = 45

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Property of HCF and LCM

The product of any two numbers is always equal to the product of their **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** and **Highest Common Factor (HCF)**.

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are **co-prime**, their **HCF** is always 1 and their **LCM** is equal to their product.

HCF of Fractions

**HCF** of fractions = (**HCF** of Numerators) ÷ (**LCM** of Denominators).</p
